description: This file defines a wizard for creating delivery orders associated with sale orders in an OpenERP/Odoo module. It includes form definitions, default value functions, and state transitions for the wizard.

classes.name: make_delivery
classes.description: A wizard interface class for creating delivery orders linked to sale orders.

methods.name: _delivery_default
methods.description: Sets default delivery information and form layout for the wizard.

methods.name: _delivery_set
methods.description: Creates delivery order lines based on selected carrier and grid.
